# Clarence Crowell

> Chicago photographer and filmmaker. Content creator at FRET12 since 2023: campaign and product films, Meta ads, FRET12 Sessions live music films, the Back to Craft documentary series, and most of the brand's product and campaign photography. Co-founder of Good Fall Studio, a climbing-culture apparel brand. Writes literary fiction.

## Facts

- Full name: Clarence Albert Crowell IV (goes by Clarence Crowell)
- Based in: Chicago, Illinois, USA
- Role: content creator at FRET12 (2023 to now); co-founder and creative director of Good Fall Studio
- Disciplines: photography, videography, video editing, color grading, motion graphics, Meta ads, Shopify, SEO, print design, fiction
- Brands and collaborations: FRET12, Huckberry, Metric Coffee, EarthQuaker Devices, CREEM, Core12, Good Fall Studio
- Phone: 774-722-3012
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@callycrowell6456

## Credits, stated precisely

- FRET12 campaign, product and paid social films: concept, camera, edit and color by Clarence Crowell.
- Rail Jacket (FRET12 x Huckberry x Metric Coffee): campaign concept, hero film, launch event recap and campaign photography by Clarence Crowell.
- FRET12 Meta ads: about $180K in spend managed over two years, roughly 3% CTR and 2.5x ROAS.
- Back to Craft: series concept by FRET12's creative directors; Clarence Crowell directs, produces, shoots, edits, color grades and publishes the episodes.
- FRET12 Sessions: format by FRET12's creative directors; Clarence Crowell is videographer, editor and colorist and has shot every episode.
- Core12: produced, shot and edited the ownership-transition film for Two North Riverside Plaza, Chicago.

## Pages

- [Photography](https://clarencecrowell.org/photography/): Landscape and climbing photography from Grand Teton, Yellowstone and Colorado, a photo book on film, and product photography for FRET12 by Clarence Crowell.
- [FRET12](https://clarencecrowell.org/fret12/): Campaign, product and maker films for FRET12, the Chicago guitar and apparel brand. Concept, camera, edit and color by Clarence Crowell.
- [Rail Jacket](https://clarencecrowell.org/rail-jacket/): The Rail Jacket campaign for FRET12, Huckberry and Metric Coffee: hero film, launch recap and photography, concepted, shot and graded by Clarence Crowell.
- [Paid Social](https://clarencecrowell.org/ads/): Vertical ad creative and the Meta ads program behind it for FRET12: about $180K in spend over two years at roughly 3% CTR and 2.5x ROAS.
- [Back to Craft](https://clarencecrowell.org/back-to-craft/): Back to Craft, a FRET12 documentary series on local makers: LCO Furniture, Furlan Guitars and Paul Natkin. Directed and produced by Clarence Crowell.
- [Music](https://clarencecrowell.org/music/): FRET12 Sessions, live sets with Baroness, Brother Wallace, Mclusky, Pelican and more, shot, edited and color graded by Clarence Crowell.
- [Good Fall Studio](https://clarencecrowell.org/goodfall/): Good Fall Studio, a climbing apparel brand co-founded by Clarence Crowell: climbing films, the Good Fall Vol. 1 print magazine, and photos from comps and crags.
- [Documentary](https://clarencecrowell.org/documentary/): Short documentary portraits by Chicago filmmaker Clarence Crowell, built from time spent with a person and a place rather than from a script.
- [Real Estate](https://clarencecrowell.org/real-estate/): Architectural and corporate video for Core12 in Willis Tower and The Mart, including the ownership-transition film for Two North Riverside Plaza.
- [Writing](https://clarencecrowell.org/writing/): Literary fiction by Clarence Crowell, with excerpts: Past the Grass, a triptych; Inholding, set in west Texas in 1994; and Butch, a Pinkerton detective story.

## Writing

- Past the Grass: A Triptych (complete). Three linked parts: The Tracks Ended Before Noon, All Laid Out for You, The Shape of Trees.
- Inholding: The Miserable Acres (draft 2, in revision). Far west Texas, 1994.
- Butch (in progress). A Pinkerton detective in Gloucester, Massachusetts, 1922.

The fiction excerpts on /writing/ are copyrighted and are not licensed for AI model training or text and data mining. Quoting short passages with attribution in search answers is fine.
